changes: Redrew Retrovision as an original pixel-art television, with a responsive video screen and controls fitted to the illustrated cabinet.
Unified year, platform, priority and genre chips on game pages, and replaced plain rating-source links with readable reference panels.
Removed the running achievement-frame spark. The stationary star now appears at different frame positions every 7–12 seconds.
Added ON AIR ignition flicker and varied bursts 40–50 seconds apart, plus individual flickering title letters. Animation preferences remain respected.
Moved seasonal Add/Restore actions into compact cover-corner plus buttons, revealed on hover or keyboard focus and visible on touch layouts.
Reorganized catalog search and filters, placing Reset filters in the same control row on wider screens and using a compact mobile grid.
Made the similar-genre labels beneath Play Next open the corresponding genre page.
